summary: Validated the new lead-gen layer (instant quote form, trust strip, sticky mobile CTA, exit-intent modal, social-proof toast, results-page Build-This CTA) + backend /api/leads/quick and /api/leads endpoints + graceful Resend/Twilio fallback. All 7 backend tests passed and every frontend lead-gen widget rendered/behaved as designed on both desktop and mobile.

minor.issue: Bug: `@api_router.post('/seed')` decorates the helper `_build_contractor` instead of the actual `seed_data()` function (server.py line 897). Hitting POST /api/seed would invoke the wrong function. Pre-existing, not in this iteration's scope but should be fixed.

Warning message says 'RESEND_API_KEY or LEAD_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL not configured' even though only RESEND_API_KEY is empty (LEAD_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL is set). Cosmetic — could split into two specific warnings for clarity.

issues: Klaviyo signup popup auto-opens on /results route and visually overlaps the new 'Build This — Free Quote' CTA card. Consider delaying or suppressing Klaviyo on the results step so the new lead CTA gets full attention.

action_items: (Optional, out-of-scope) Fix /api/seed decorator pointing at the wrong function in server.py.
(Optional UX) Defer/suppress Klaviyo popup on Results page so it doesn't cover the new Build-This CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py @api_router.post('/seed') decorator is attached to the helper `_build_contractor` rather than the async `seed_data` function — silent latent bug.
notifications.send_lead_email warning text conflates two missing-env scenarios; split for easier ops debugging.
ExitIntentModal mousemove(500,-10) successfully fires mouseleave on top edge — covered by tests. SessionStorage flag correctly prevents re-display.
LeadGenWidgets correctly excludes /admin and /contractor/dashboard via route allow-list.
test_credentials: Admin password: renovate2024admin (not exercised in this iteration; admin route was only used to verify LeadGenWidgets are excluded).
seed_data_creation: Inserted 6 TEST_-prefixed lead docs into MongoDB via the API. Inserted one completed project with id 'test-buildthis-a47904d0' for verifying the Build-This CTA on /results.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend lead notifications gracefully log 'Lead email skipped' + 'Lead SMS skipped' warnings while still creating the lead (verified in supervisor logs). When RESEND_API_KEY / TWILIO_* get filled, the notify_new_lead path should be re-tested end-to-end. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_leads.py is reusable for regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found in the lead-gen feature set. Two minor pre-existing items called out under backend_issues.minor.
verified_features: POST /api/leads/quick — valid input returns 200 with {id, status:'new', message} (5 test cases).
POST /api/leads/quick — empty name or empty/whitespace phone returns 400 'Name and phone are required'.
POST /api/leads/quick — optional fields email/zip_code/project_type/source all persist (verified via Mongo query).
POST /api/leads — still works post-refactor, sets source='quote_form' automatically (verified via Mongo query).
Notifications skip cleanly when API keys are empty — supervisor logs show 'Lead email skipped' + 'Lead SMS skipped' warnings; lead still saved.
Homepage: instant-quote-form-hero_form + trust-strip render on desktop.
Hero form empty submit → toast 'Add your name and phone — that's all I need.'
Hero form valid submit → success toast + success state 'You're on Ryan's list.'
Sticky mobile CTA hidden on desktop, visible on 375x800 mobile with all 3 sub-buttons (call/text/studio).
Exit-intent modal triggers on mouseleave-top, dismisses, and sessionStorage 'sh_exit_intent_seen' is set.
Social-proof toast appears ~6s after homepage load on desktop; hidden on mobile (hidden md:block).
LeadGenWidgets NOT mounted on /admin or /contractor/dashboard (verified absence of sticky + social-proof in DOM).
ResultsPage: build-this-btn renders with text 'Build This — Free Quote' above designs grid when project is completed.
